product_overview: ceknomor.id is a mobile-first website for checking Indonesian phone numbers and bank accounts to see whether they have been reported for fraud, spam, or other suspicious activity. It also helps users explore trending scam data and read educational articles to avoid online scams.
core_goals: Check a phone number before responding or transacting
Check a bank account before transferring money
See scam reports, comments, and safety status for a number or account
Discover trending numbers and accounts that are frequently searched or reported
Learn scam-prevention tips through educational articles

features.name: Phone Number Check
features.description: Users can search an Indonesian phone number to see its safety status, report count, comment count, category, and latest report information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter a phone number -> Submit the search -> See the result summary with safety status, report count, comment count, category, and latest report date
Navigate to / -> Enter a phone number -> Submit the search -> Open the result page -> Review the detailed report history and community information

features.name: Bank Account Check
features.description: Users can search an Indonesian bank account to see whether it has been reported, along with its safety label and related community feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter a bank name and account number -> Submit the search -> See the result summary with safety status, report count, comment count, category, and owner name when available
Navigate to / -> Enter a bank name and account number -> Submit the search -> Open the result page -> Review the detailed account history and community feedback

features.name: Search Results Detail Page
features.description: Users can review the detailed findings for a phone number or bank account after searching.
user_flows: Navigate to /hasil -> Review the safety label -> Read the total reports and comments -> View the category and last reported information -> Decide whether the number or account appears safe
Navigate to /hasil -> Review the community summary -> Read the latest user comments and reports -> Compare the overall risk level -> Return to search with a better-informed decision

features.name: Trending and Popular Lookups
features.description: Users can view currently popular numbers and accounts, including the most searched and most reported items.
user_flows: Navigate to /trending -> Review the latest scam search trends -> See the most searched numbers and accounts -> Open a trending item from the list -> Inspect why it is being discussed
Navigate to /leaderboard -> Review the most reported numbers and accounts -> Compare items by report volume -> Identify the riskiest entries before making a transaction

features.name: Community Reporting
features.description: Users can contribute new scam intelligence by reporting a phone number or bank account under a relevant category.
user_flows: Navigate to /hasil -> Open a report action for the current number or account -> Choose a report category -> Submit the report -> See the database update with one more contribution
Navigate to / -> Search a suspicious phone number or bank account -> Open the reporting flow from the result -> Choose a category such as scam, spam, or debt collector -> Submit the report

features.name: Anonymous Comments and Voting
features.description: Users can leave anonymous comments about a number or account and vote on whether other comments are helpful.
user_flows: Navigate to /hasil -> Open the comment flow -> Write an anonymous comment about the number or account -> Submit the comment -> See the comment appear in the discussion
Navigate to /hasil -> Read an existing comment -> Mark the comment as helpful or not helpful -> See the community feedback update

features.name: Educational Articles
features.description: Users can read articles and tips that explain how to avoid online scams and identify suspicious behavior.
user_flows: Navigate to /artikel -> Browse scam-prevention articles -> Open an article of interest -> Read guidance about common scam patterns and safety tips
Navigate to /artikel -> Search or scan the article listings -> Open a related education page -> Learn how to check a number or account before transferring money

routes.description: Halaman utama pengecekan nomor telepon dan rekening bank penipu
Halaman hasil pencarian dan rincian rekam jejak penipuan
Halaman peringkat nomor dan rekening paling banyak dilaporkan
Halaman statistik dan tren laporan penipuan online terbaru
Halaman edukasi dan artikel pencegahan penipuan online
